$description: Republike design tokens — single source for both republike-ios and republike-android. The Phase 1 codegen script reads this and emits Tokens.swift + Tokens.kt.

primary.$description: purple-main — primary brand color (matches the React Native app, Colors.primary)

primaryPressed.$description: DA action/primary-pressed — pressed state of the brand-violet fill

brandSubtle.$description: DA bg/brand-subtle — faint violet fill (subtle brand chips/badges)

disabled.$description: DA action/disabled — fill of a disabled button (replaces the old 40% opacity)

accentOrange.$description: DA bg/attention orange-500 — the like/heart colour in the DA (the DA has no pink; replaces the old pink heart #E11D48)

secondary.$description: DA text/secondary — @handle, meta, inactive tab labels (new DA value, was #4B5563)

disabled.$description: DA text/disabled — label of a disabled control

onPrimary.$description: DA text/on-brand — text/icon on the brand-violet fill

onBrand.$description: DA dark-editorial token — text/on-brand (#FFFFFF) as white editorial text on the dark brand surface (surface.dark) of the founder-principle screens. Same Figma variable text/on-brand as text.onPrimary, named per the dark-on-brand usage.

background.$description: DA bg/canvas — app canvas behind surfaces (new DA value, was #F8F8FF). NOTE: the feed grey background is removed in the DA — posts are full-width on bg/surface white, hairline-separated.

card.$description: DA bg/surface — white surface for posts, sheets, fields

muted.$description: DA bg/surface-muted — flat icon-button fill, poll option rows, chips

selected.$description: DA bg/selected — light-violet selected surface (selected poll option, selected row)

divider.$description: DA border/default — standard 1px border (fields, dividers; new DA value, was #E5E7EB)

cardBorder.$description: DA border/subtle — the 1px hairline that separates full-width posts on white (DA removes the rounded card; this is the inter-post separator), and the header/tab-bar hairlines (new DA value, was #F3F4F6)

dark.$description: DA dark-editorial token — neutral/950, the near-black brand surface used as the full-screen background of the founder-principle (principes fondateurs) dark onboarding screens. Pairs with text.onBrand / icon.onBrand (white).

darkElevated.$description: DA dark-editorial token — translucent elevated/overlay fill (white @ ~14%) on surface.dark; used for the 'PRINCIPE FONDATEUR' pill/chip (which also carries a 1px icon.onBrand/white border). Not a named Figma role; the dark principle frames apply it as a raw fill.

muted.$description: DA icon/muted — post action-row icons (Remix 20), '···' menu, secondary glyphs. (icon/default = text.primary, icon/brand = primary, icon/on-brand = text.onPrimary.)

onBrand.$description: DA dark-editorial token — icon/on-brand (#FFFFFF), white icons (e.g. the back chevron) on the dark brand surface (surface.dark) of the founder-principle screens.

fill.$description: DA avatar/violet/fond — light-violet background of the no-photo (initials) avatar (replaces the old saturated violet gradient)

pattern.$description: DA avatar/violet/motif — violet-700 initials/glyph on the no-photo avatar (replaces the old white initials)

error.$description: DA text/error (red-600) — destructive action text (Supprimer, Signaler, …) and error messages (new DA value, was #DC2626)

main.$description: interface font — all UI text (nav, cards, lists, body, labels). SIL OFL, free to bundle.

brand.$description: brand-voice font — brand moments only, at most one per screen (SCRUM-449). The DA brand font is Base Neue (PAID, Power Type Foundry, license pending). Saira (SIL OFL, free) is the bundled stand-in. This value is the family string consumed by Font.custom / R.font, so it must match the bundled file; once a Base Neue licence is confirmed and the file bundled, change this value to "Base Neue" (one line) and nothing else.

editorial.$description: DA dark-editorial token — Titre/Éditorial mobile size (Base Neue Condensed Extra Bold 30/30) for founder-principle titles; rendered in typography.fontFamily.brand. Desktop uses 44.

extrabold.$description: DA dark-editorial token — Extra Bold for Titre/Éditorial (founder-principle titles). Figma's Base Neue variable axis reports this as 'Condensed Extra Bold' (≈797); 800 is the standard-scale mapping.

md.$description: DA radius/md — buttons, inputs, chips (new DA value, was 8)

pill.$description: DA radius/full — pills, circular avatars/icon-buttons (new DA value, was 9999)
